title: Bound the retimed role 992 producer repair
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** On exact #7481 at `89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b`, retime the old role-992 chart-529 arrival and try to remove the final rank-one arrival of owned 1532 at event 39884. The fixed bank has rank 12. The old 992 target and old post-transfer 913 target raise the rank to 14. Two probes annihilate all 12 fixed rows and give target values (1,2) and (0,1). One incoming scalar cannot supply both missing directions. One case exhausted within the 30-second cap.

The hypothetical deletion saves exactly 17 raw units before costs on the signed #7113 caller. One rank-one replacement per call consumes the entire gross. Changing the existing role-1451 path, other receiver rows or the chart itinerary remains open.

## Replay

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12, run `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-role992-retimed-producer-bound/replay.py`. Reverse coefficient reconstruction and independent signed forward probes agree on both target evaluations. The package authenticates exact inputs and deterministic receipts, checks rank-one pricing and rejects corrupt-source and collapsed-target controls. Registered replay, commit and source checks, official Git-free replay and all 27 onboarding tests passed locally.
